title: When Code Gets Cheap, Evaluation Gets Scarce: An Experience Report on AI-Assisted Agile Software Engineering
abstract: arXiv:2610.30916v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Coding assistants are widely reported to speed up code production; most accounts stop there. We report the end-to-end construction and deployment of a compliance-critical, human-in-the-loop exam-grading system, built by a single developer who wrote no code by hand, protected by a gated process from stakeholder persona to audited behavior. The initial system was built in three working days and could grade a real cohort. We draw one claim from this experience: AI changes software engineering less by making programming faster than by changing what is scarce. Writing code becomes abundant. Reliable evaluation-knowing whether a result is correct and meets the actual need-remains necessary at every iteration and becomes the binding constraint. Engineering judgment remains a second scarcity. Several defects passed the test suite: they sat at the boundaries the tests had mocked, the browser and the language-model API, or appeared only in real us

translated_title: 当代码变得廉价，评估变得稀缺：一份关于AI辅助敏捷软件工程的经验报告
translated_abstract: 编码助手被广泛报道能加速代码生产，但大多数叙述止步于此。我们报告了一个合规关键、人在回路的考试评分系统的端到端构建与部署过程：该系统由一名开发者独立完成，全程未手写任何代码，并受到一个门控流程的保护——从利益相关者画像到经过审计的系统行为。初始系统在三个工作日内建成，并能够对真实的考生群体进行评分。我们从这一经验中得出一个论断：AI对软件工程的改变，与其说是让编程变得更快，不如说是改变了什么是稀缺资源。编写代码变得充裕，而可靠的评估——即判断结果是否正确并满足实际需求——在每次迭代中仍然不可或缺，并成为约束性的瓶颈。工程判断力是第二种稀缺资源。若干缺陷通过了测试套件：它们位于测试所模拟的边界处——浏览器和语言模型API——或者仅在实际使用中才显现出来。
tldr: 本文通过一名开发者仅用三天、未手写一行代码便构建并部署合规关键的考试评分系统的实战经验，提出AI对软件工程的核心影响不是加速编程，而是改变稀缺资源——代码变得充裕，而可靠评估和工程判断成为新的约束性瓶颈。
en_tdlr: Based on an experience report where a single developer built and deployed a compliance-critical exam-grading system in three days without hand-writing any code, this paper argues that AI's core impact on software engineering is not faster programming but a shift in scarcity: code becomes abundant, while reliable evaluation and engineering judgment become the binding constraints.
